abide women's conference 2026 | 20 –22 november: join hundreds of women at the great northern hotel, bundoran, co. donegal , in just a few weeks for our third abide women's conference! speakers include sarah swafford, danielle noonan, kimberlee woo ling, fr oisín martin cfr, fr barry braum, the nashville dominican sisters, fr david nugent and fr mark wharton, with holy mass celebrated by bishop fintan gavin. a beautiful weekend of faith, celebration, healing and joy! register on eventbrite: abide in his love ireland's 3rd national first saturdays conference will take place in knock on saturday november 28th. the day begins at 10am and finishes at 5pm. it includes holy mass, adoration, talks, and a healing service. speakers include fr patrick cahill, geraldine o'donnell, fr leon pereira op, nikki kingsley, fr marius o'reilly, fr. jaimie twohig, christine o'hara, fr. mark quinn, and fr philip kemmy, fr. john keane will lead a eucharistic healing service. more information and the list of buses going are available on
